proposed_english: just; only; exactly; correct; fair; just

note: The current gloss foregrounds marginal senses ('don', 'run') and omits core learner uses. A safer high-frequency gloss is pass/go by, spend time, take an exam, put on/hand/pass something.
proposed_english: to pass; to go/come by; to spend (time); to take (an exam); to hand/pass; to put on

note: jamais means 'ever' in questions/conditionals but, with negation or as a negative response, its core learner meaning is 'never'; omitting 'never' is materially misleading.

proposed_english: to arrive; to happen/occur; to manage/succeed (arriver à); to achieve success (context-dependent)

proposed_english: now; currently; maintaining (present participle of maintenir, context-dependent)
